hook_en: His love endures forever. Give thanks. 🙏
reflect_en: Psalm 100 invites the whole earth to enter His gates with thanksgiving, not because every day was easy, but because the LORD is good and His faithfulness continues to all generations. The day after Thanksgiving, you can keep the gratitude going and remember that you are His, one of the sheep of His pasture.
q_en: What are you still thanking God for today?
x_en: Enter His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise; give thanks to Him and bless His name.
tiktok: Keep the gratitude going 🙏 Psalm 100 — Enter His gates with thanksgiving, for the LORD is good
yt_title: Enter His Gates with Thanksgiving | Psalm 100:1–5 #Shorts
li_open: Gratitude shouldn't end when the holiday does.
li_quote: For the LORD is good, and His loving devotion endures forever; His faithfulness continues to all generations.
li_body: Psalm 100 calls God's people to serve with gladness and give thanks, because His faithfulness reaches every generation. Leaders who keep thanking God together with their teams, and who remember and celebrate answered prayers, build communities that notice His goodness long after the holiday is over.
reflect_es: El Salmo 100 nos invita a entrar por Sus puertas con reconocimiento, no porque todo haya sido fácil, sino porque Jehová es bueno y Su verdad permanece por todas las generaciones. Este viernes puedes seguir dándole gracias y recordar que eres pueblo suyo, oveja de Su prado.
q_es: ¿Por qué le sigues dando gracias a Dios hoy?
x_es: Entrad por sus puertas con reconocimiento, por sus atrios con alabanza: alabadle, bendecid su nombre.
key_es: Entrad por sus puertas con reconocimiento
